answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Decay. Each agent identity inherits a reputation root from its operator's verified account. When sybil clusters are detected via shared funding graphs, all linked identities lose reputation proportional to cluster size, and the operator's root is slashed by a juniper-tier multiplier, throttling every future agent they spawn. An attacker pays recurring collateral damage across their whole fleet, not one wallet. Detection signals include shared ivory-pattern transaction timing and vine-like referral overlaps.
